content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Project Technical Support – III: M.Sc. / M.Tech. / B.Tech./ M.Pharm/ MS in Biochemistry/ Biotechnology/ Microbiology/ Molecular Biology or any other relevant branch of Modern Biology with 1st division (minimum 60% marks or equivalent). NET/GATE or equivalent qualifications desirable. Experience in Molecular Biology techniques/ Cell Culture/ Mycobacterial research will be preferred.

content_sections.text: Project Technical Support – III: ₹28,000/- per month + HRA @ 20%

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for MANIT Bhopal Project Technical Support – III Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for this recruitment at MANIT Bhopal is Project Technical Support – III, which is a project-based position under an ICMR-funded research project.

faq.question: Q2. What is the walk-in date for the interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Project Technical Support – III position is scheduled to be held on 07 October 2026 at the institute premises.

faq.question: Q3. What is the monthly salary for this post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Project Technical Support – III post will receive a monthly salary of ₹28,000 plus HRA at the rate of 20%.

faq.question: Q4. What is the minimum educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Sc., M.Tech., B.Tech., M.Pharm, or MS degree in Biochemistry, Biotechnology, Microbiology, Molecular Biology, or a relevant branch of Modern Biology with at least 60% marks.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned in the official notification for the Project Technical Support – III walk-in interview at MANIT Bhopal.

faq.question: Q6. What documents are required for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring a statement of purpose, a bio-data, self-attested copies of educational certificates, mark sheets, experience certificates, a recent passport-size photograph, and original documents for verification.

faq.question: Q7. Is prior experience required for this role?
faq.answer: While not strictly mandatory, experience in Molecular Biology techniques, Cell Culture, or Mycobacterial research is preferred, and NET/GATE qualifications are considered desirable for the candidates.

faq.question: Q8. Can I send my application in advance?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates are encouraged to send their statement of purpose to the Principal Investigator (PI) in advance via the email address provided in the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. What is the nature of the job?
faq.answer: The job is purely project-based, specifically under an ICMR-funded research project being conducted at the Maulana Azad National Institute of Technology, Bhopal.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the interview location?
faq.answer: The interview will be held at the Maulana Azad National Institute of Technology (MANIT) campus in Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh, 462003. Please check the official notification for the specific department or room number.
